info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create File Payment Consent File-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of file payment consent requests within the open banking framework. It allows financial institutions to securely process bulk payment consents by uploading files that include multiple consents, streamlining operations and enhancing customer service. Typical consumers include banks and payment service providers looking to manage payments efficiently and comply with regulatory requirements. The API enables the integration of file-based transaction authorizations, ensuring secure and compliant financial interactions.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new file payment consent for the specified resource. It processes the request to file payment consents which are crucial for the initiation of payment transactions.
